4: # Kẻ địch ninja — bản thử kỹ thuật (giá trị TẠM THỜI).
5: signal defeated
6: 
7: const SPEED := 90.0
8: const GRAVITY := 1000.0
9: const CHASE_RANGE := 220.0
10: const ATTACK_RANGE := 34.0
11: const ATTACK_DAMAGE := 12
12: const ATTACK_COOLDOWN := 1.0
13: 
14: var health: int = 60
15: var max_health: int = 60
16: var facing: int = 1
17: var _cooldown: float = 0.0
18: var _patrol_dir: int = 1
19: var _player: Node2D = null
20: 
21: func _ready() -> void:
22: 	_patrol_dir = 1 if randf() < 0.5 else -1
23: 
24: func set_player(p: Node2D) -> void:
25: 	_player = p
26: 
27: func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
28: 	_cooldown = maxf(0.0, _cooldown - delta)
29: 	velocity.y += GRAVITY * delta
30: 	if _player != null and is_instance_valid(_player):
31: 		var dx: float = _player.position.x - position.x
32: 		if absf(dx) < CHASE_RANGE:
33: 			facing = 1 if dx > 0.0 else -1
34: 			velocity.x = facing * SPEED
35: 			if absf(dx) < ATTACK_RANGE and _cooldown <= 0.0:
36: 				_cooldown = ATTACK_COOLDOWN
37: 				if _player.has_method("take_damage"):
38: 					_player.take_damage(ATTACK_DAMAGE)
39: 		else:
40: 			velocity.x = _patrol_dir * SPEED * 0.6
41: 			facing = _patrol_dir
42: 	else:
43: 		velocity.x = _patrol_dir * SPEED * 0.6
44: 		facing = _patrol_dir
45: 	move_and_slide()
46: 	# Đổi hướng khi chạm tường.
47: 	if is_on_wall():
48: 		_patrol_dir = -_patrol_dir
49: 	queue_redraw()
50: 
51: func take_damage(amount: int) -> void:
52: 	if health <= 0:
53: 		return
54: 	health = maxi(0, health - amount)
55: 	if health <= 0:
56: 		defeated.emit()
57: 		queue_free()
58: 
59: func reset() -> void:
60: 	health = max_health
